export const slug = (s: string): string =>
  s
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'project'

export const projectOf = (cwd: string): string => slug(cwd.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '')

// Claude Code keeps a session's transcript at ~/.claude/projects/<cwd with non-alphanumerics as dashes>/<id>.jsonl.
export const transcriptOf = (cwd: string, id: string): string =>
  `~/.claude/projects/${cwd.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '-')}/${id}.jsonl`

// One folder per session: <project>/<date>_<id8>/.
export const folderName = (date: string, id: string): string => `${date}_${id.slice(0, 8)}`

export const stateOf = (dir: string): string => `${dir}/state.md`
export const stepsOf = (dir: string): string => `${dir}/steps.md`
export const historyOf = (dir: string): string => `${dir}/history.md`
export const eventsOf = (dir: string): string => `${dir}/events.jsonl`
export const pendingOf = (dir: string): string => `${dir}/pending.json`

export const dirOf = (path: string): string => path.slice(0, path.lastIndexOf('/'))

export const baseOf = (path: string): string => path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)

import { factsText, shortPath } from './facts'
import { activeNotes } from './notes'
import { tidy } from './redact'
import { learnLabel, noteLabel, roleOf } from './state'
import type { FileEntry, State, Turn, TurnRecord } from './types'

const STEPS = 15
const EARLIER = 10
const EARLIER_CHARS = 1500
const PREVIOUS_CHARS = 6000
const USER_CHARS = 10000
const ANSWER_CHARS = 6000
const LOOKED_CHARS = 6000

// What Haiku reads for one turn. `earlier` are the archived turns before this one; `looked` is an older
// turn it asked for.
export type TurnContext = {
  state: State
  steps: readonly string[]
  earlier: readonly TurnRecord[]
  files: readonly FileEntry[]
  turn: Turn
  looked?: TurnRecord
}

// Edited this turn and not yet given a role: the files Haiku is asked to describe.
export const unnamedFiles = (c: Pick<TurnContext, 'state' | 'turn'>): string[] =>
  c.turn.facts.edited.filter(p => roleOf(c.state, p) === '')

const list = (lines: string[]): string => (lines.length === 0 ? '(none)' : lines.join('\n'))

export const contextText = (c: TurnContext): string => {
  const cwd = c.state.front.cwd ?? ''
  const notes = activeNotes(c.state).map(n => `${noteLabel(n.id)} [${n.kind}] ${n.text}${n.why === '' ? '' : ` (why: ${n.why})`}`)
  const learnings = c.state.learnings.filter(l => l.status === 'active').map(l => `${learnLabel(l.id)} [${l.kind}] ${l.text}`)
  const files = c.files.map(f => `${shortPath(f.path, cwd)}${roleOf(c.state, f.path) === '' ? '' : ` · ${roleOf(c.state, f.path)}`}`)
  const earlier = c.earlier.slice(-EARLIER).map(r => `t${r.turn}: ${tidy(r.user, EARLIER_CHARS)}`)
  const f = c.turn.facts
  const failures = f.failures.map(x => `failed: ${x.command}\n${x.error}`)
  const unnamed = unnamedFiles(c).map(p => shortPath(p, cwd))
  return [
    `Current title: ${c.state.front.title === undefined || c.state.front.title === '' ? '(none)' : c.state.front.title}`,
    '',
    'Active notes (the ledger), oldest first:',
    list(notes),
    '',
    'Active learnings:',
    list(learnings),
    '',
    'Files that matter:',
    list(files),
    '',
    `Last ${STEPS} steps:`,
    list(c.steps.slice(-STEPS)),
    '',
    "The user's earlier messages, oldest first:",
    list(earlier),
    '',
    ...(c.looked === undefined
      ? []
      : [`Turn t${c.looked.turn}, which you asked for:`, `User: ${tidy(c.looked.user, LOOKED_CHARS)}`, `Agent: ${tidy(c.looked.answer, LOOKED_CHARS)}`, '']),
    'Previous agent reply:',
    c.turn.previousAnswer === '' ? '(none)' : tidy(c.turn.previousAnswer, PREVIOUS_CHARS),
    '',
    `THIS TURN, t${c.turn.turn}. The user's message:`,
    tidy(c.turn.user, USER_CHARS),
    '',
    "The agent's reply:",
    c.turn.answer === '' ? '(none)' : tidy(c.turn.answer, ANSWER_CHARS),
    '',
    `What the tools did: ${factsText(f, cwd) || 'nothing'}`,
    ...(f.edited.length === 0 ? [] : [`Edited: ${f.edited.map(p => shortPath(p, cwd)).join(', ')}`]),
    ...failures,
    ...(unnamed.length === 0 ? [] : [`Edited files with no role yet: ${unnamed.join(', ')}`]),
  ].join('\n')
}

// The plugin's state contract. It must stand alone, so it mirrors core/types.ts rather than importing it.

export type Usage = { input: number; output: number; cacheRead: number; cacheWrite: number }

export type Failure = { command: string; error: string }

export type TurnFacts = { read: string[]; edited: string[]; commands: number; failures: Failure[]; commits: string[] }

export type GateEvent = {
  type: 'gate'
  at: number
  turn: number
  turnId: string
  p: number | null
  model: string
  ms: number
  inputTokens: number
  cost: number
  action: 'extract' | 'skip' | 'audit' | 'error' | 'off'
  error?: string
}

export type ExtractEvent = {
  type: 'extract'
  at: number
  turn: number
  turnId: string
  model: string
  mode: 'summarize' | 'extract'
  ms: number
  usage: Usage
  kept: number
  learned: number
  closed: number
  roles: number
  need?: number
  dropped: string[]
  error?: string
}

export type TurnRecord = { type: 'turn'; at: number; turn: number; turnId: string; user: string; answer: string; facts: TurnFacts }

export type LedgerEvent = GateEvent | ExtractEvent | TurnRecord

export type PendingTurn = {
  turn: number
  turnId: string
  user: string
  answer: string
  previousAnswer: string
  isAborted: boolean
  facts: TurnFacts
}

export type Status = { isBusy: boolean; turn: number; message: string }

export type Tab = 'steps' | 'ledger' | 'stats'

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'session-state': {
      sessionId: string
      dir: string
      origin: string
      md: string
      steps: string
      events: LedgerEvent[]
      queue: PendingTurn[]
      failed: PendingTurn[]
      pendingUser: string
      previousAnswer: string
      facts: TurnFacts
      turns: number
      status: Status
      isPaused: boolean
      isCompacted: boolean
      tab: Tab
      isHistoryShown: boolean
    }
  }
}
